page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number at right. A woodcut (crucifixion scene with lions) fills the upper left, with marginal notes to its left ("Suetonius cap. XXI", "In Neronem"). Right of the woodcut, a column of text continues to the bottom of the upper section, with marginal notes at its right ("Tertullianus", "Et Suetonius"). Below the woodcut and column, a Greek line runs across the full width. Then a chapter heading, a subheading, and two paragraphs of text in a single column, with marginal notes at right ("Mortuiin Crucem dati") and left ("Suet. cap. LXXXIIII").

main_text.l: ipse ferâ pelle contectus, emissus è
è Dione : Μαεχῖα νοὶ χοεχας σαωεχις γυμνὰς ᾳεχοδέων, ᾧ μεἰου τέ ἰυ-νος δοεχὶ αὐελαμβανε, ὠ ᾳεχοπίπλων σφισὶν ἠσέλχαυνεν, ὥσπερ τὶ ἐδίων.
AC postremò Crux Fine alia, cùm non viui sed
mortui in eâ appensi. Notabis. & quod nobis sollenne
in rotâ exponere supplicio iam affectos, ad
notam sceleris & infamiam, id olim in Cruce, &
lêgi. nisi quòd Cæsar piratas, à quibus
captus esset, cùm in deditionem redegisset, quoniam suffixurum
se cruci iurauerat, iugulari priùs iussit, atque

page.notes: Left margin notes: "Suetonius cap. XXI" beside the woodcut and "In Neronem" below it; "Suet. cap. LXXXIIII" beside the last paragraph. Woodcut shows a crucified figure with lions and bears; described, not transcribed. Greek line is transcribed as printed with some letters uncertain.
